name: 634. A promotional rate bills the standard rate from the promotion's last day (vendor promotion end dates)
description: TXE-7763. The upstream datasheet publishes Databricks' promotional rates for GPT-5.6 Sol (through 21 Nov 2026) and Gemini 4 Argon (through 30 Nov 2026) and carries no end date. The gateway records each promotion in upstreamPromotions (framework/modelcatalog/datasheet/sync.go) and, from its last day in UTC, bills the standard rate in its place. The fixture's pricing sheet carries both rows exactly as upstream published them on 18 Nov 2026. Each row reads the rates back from the model catalog and expects the promotional rate before the last day and the standard rate from it, by today's UTC date.
